_about: Hand-picked video lists, kept in order on purpose. build-sections.py reads this file through pinned_lists.py. Copy an id exactly as the API has it; the title is what the card shows.

trending._notes: Homepage 'Trending on NIL TV', shown exactly in this order: the network's most viewed (top 5 all time, then recent heat, then each channel's best). NIL Star clips are left out. The TrueBlue pick is by hand because the archive has no Instagram metrics. Empty the list to fall back to the live newest-first feed.
